title: Top Smartphones of 2026: Our Overall Picks
summary: The top 2026 smartphones are the iPhone 18 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, and Google Pixel 10a, each praised by multiple experts.
method: Picks were made by cross‑referencing Tom's Guide and TechRadar recommendations; products mentioned by both sources were selected.
assumptions: Prices reflect listed amounts; actual store pricing may vary and no specific retailer was cited in the excerpts.

products.name: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max
why: Tom's Guide calls the iPhone 18 Pro Max the top overall phone, highlighting its variable‑aperture camera, longer battery life (18½ hours) and the powerful A20 Pro chip despite a $100 price hike.
TechRadar notes the same A20 Pro performance, a 48 MP main sensor with mechanical variable aperture, 30 hours of mixed‑use battery life and fast wired charging to 50 % in 15 minutes.
specs: 48 MP main camera with variable aperture (ƒ/1.48‑ƒ/4.0)
18 hours 27 minutes battery life in lab test
Super Retina XDR OLED display with ProMotion and Always‑On
cons: Large size compared to previous models
products.best_for: Users who want the best iPhone experience and can afford a premium flagship

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
why: Tom's Guide ranks the Galaxy S26 Ultra as the top Android pick, praising its 200 MP main sensor, 50 MP telephoto lens and unique Horizon Lock video stabilization.
TechRadar echoes its camera supremacy, AI features, and the new Privacy Display that shields screen content, while noting its strong battery life and fast charging.
specs: 50 MP telephoto lens with wider aperture
Privacy Display with reduced viewing angles
AI assistant features like Now Brief
Same battery capacity as previous generation but with faster charging
cons: Large camera bump makes flat placement awkward
No built‑in Qi2 magnets for MagSafe‑style accessories
products.best_for: Power users who need top‑tier photography and AI tools on Android
products.skip_if: You prefer a smaller, more pocket‑friendly phone

products.name: Google Pixel 10a
why: Tom's Guide recommends the Pixel 10a as the best under‑$500 phone, noting its great Android experience at a lower price point around $500.
TechRadar lists the Pixel 10a as the top budget pick, emphasizing its value for money and solid overall performance.
specs: Good camera performance for its class
cons: Not as powerful as premium flagships
products.best_for: Consumers seeking a capable smartphone without breaking the bank
products.skip_if: You need flagship‑level specs and premium features
